name: Gallagher Insurance
verdict: Gallagher is the brand of Arthur J. Gallagher & Co., a US insurance broker listed on the New York Stock Exchange whose largest holders are the asset managers Vanguard (9.9%), JP Morgan Chase (7.8%), BlackRock (6.9%) and Capital World Investors (5.0%). Nothing found.
note: Official Platinum Partner of New Zealand Rugby (allblacks.com/partners, checked 2026-10-04; the partner tile links to ajg.com, Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.'s site).
